Scenario_Title: Mishap Prediction Benchmark #029: Cooling Water Thermal Instability Cascade in HDS-1

Available_Evidence: Cooling water supply temperature rose to 33.8 C
CDU-4 overhead reflux condenser approach temperature degraded to 4.2 C
Hidden_Risk_Factors: Bio-fouling on cooling tower fill packs reduced evaporative surface area

Expected_AI_Observations: Correlate external severe ambient heatwave with refinery-wide cooling water header thermal dissipation bottleneck.
Expected_Risk_Assessment: Loss of column overhead condensing capacity forcing crude charge derate and potential relief valve lifting.
